Fill in the blanks with the correct preposition:
(a) My parents live ________ London.
(b) Maurice is going _______ the cinema tonight?
(c) I saw Liza ________ the mall yesterday.
(d) Pauline and her family are going ______ a holiday next week.
(e) There is a bridge ________ the river.
(f) Some people always hanker ___________ money.
(g) There are many posters of Taylor Swift ______ my wall.
(h) A person must always abide ___________ the rules.
(i) Come _______ the dining room, let’s have dinner.
(j) Mt. Everest lies 8,848 meters _________ sea level. (10×1=10)

Change the speech of the following sentences :
(a) The little boy told his mother that he was hungry.
(b) The man asked me where I lived.
(c) The teacher said, “All men are mortal.”
(d) Father said, “Mother will be home soon.”
(e) The king ordered the servant to bring his crown.
(f) The man says, “It was very cold in the morning.”
(g) The little girl exclaimed with joy that it was a pretty doll.
(h) The boy will say, “The servant has broken the vase.”
(i) Mawia said, “I have finished my work.”
(j) The boy begged his father to buy him a new toy. (10×1=10)

Fill in the blanks with the correct form of verbs given in brackets :
(a) He ____ here since 2009. (work)
(b) Have you ____ any thoughts on this matter? (give)
(c) Mother has never _____ of her childhood. (speak)
(d) This book ____ only 50 rupees last year. (cost)
(e) The man ____ a criminal. (be)
(f) He jumped off the bus while it ____ . (move)
(g) The sun ____ in the east. (rise) (10×1=10)
(h) I did not ____ anything last night. (hear)
(i) I ___ her while I was in Lunglei. (meet)
(j) You should not ____ that last week. (do)

Rewrite the following sentences as directed :
(a) He died in the village where he was born. (change to simple sentence)
(b) We can prove that the earth is round. (change to compound sentence)
(c) He declared his innocence. (change to complex sentence)
(d) We must eat, or we cannot live. (change to simple sentence)
(e) Night came on. The room grew dark. (change to compound sentence) (5×2=10)
